intro.title: 60 Days. 60 Builds. One Learning Streak.
intro.description: ABTalks is a 60-day coding challenge where college students build something every day and share their learning journey publicly.
intro.motivation: Turn consistent learning into a visible portfolio of progress.

howItWorks.title: Build
howItWorks.description: Create something every day and keep learning through practice.

howItWorks.title: Commit
howItWorks.description: Submit your GitHub commit as proof of your daily progress.

howItWorks.title: Share
howItWorks.description: Share your learning journey publicly through a LinkedIn post.

benefits.title: Build Consistency
benefits.description: Develop the habit of coding and making progress every day.

benefits.title: Build a Public Portfolio
benefits.description: Turn your daily work into visible evidence of your skills.

benefits.title: Stay Accountable
benefits.description: GitHub commits and LinkedIn posts make your progress measurable.

benefits.title: Learn by Building
benefits.description: Apply what you learn instead of only consuming tutorials.

callToAction.title: Ready to start your 60-day journey?
callToAction.description: Start small, stay consistent, and let your progress speak for itself.
